lineage_source.rule: test_id is byte-identical to each mandated replacement_test_id; aliases and shortened IDs are forbidden

tests.setup: After exact human ratification, validate all bound protocol/source/runtime hashes, the exact semantic_consistency_matrix.json normative-file inventory and every producer/consumer/object/ordering/validity/ledger edge, the sole opportunity_ledger.schema.json, scope, ceilings, review schemas, platform-attested actor-separation rules, authority-token predecessor links, G namespace isolation, and terminal routes over the implemented CPU artifact set.
tests.expected: Every file and semantic edge in the exhaustive matrix is present and consistent; every unlisted or contradictory producer, consumer, object, ordering, validity, or ledger byte is rejected as INVALID_PRECONDITION/PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION. Only ratification to CPU implementation to reviewed DEV to reviewed heldout text to reviewed conditional two-fit LoRA to HUMAN_TERMINAL is reachable.

tests.setup: Mutate private fields, audit prose/confidence/predictions, results, forbidden aliases/paths, unauthorized focus echoes, donor identity, and G fixture metadata; compare selectors, closed states, final rendered provider tokens, readers, compiler views, candidates, training examples, and LoRA-backed read-result bytes.
tests.expected: Every forbidden mutation is byte-inert; only the registered OWN/DIST focus treatment may change its explicitly authorized provider-visible field.

tests.setup: Exercise every kind/arity/atom namespace, witnessed and dreamed compatibility tuple, proposal/check verdict, explicit model-cited distinct-lineage support, duplicate ownership, conflict, E-to-M witness mapping, depth, cycle, diamond, hash, and DEV G-namespace separation vector.
tests.expected: Only immutable witnessed rows and immutable model-SUPPORTED dreamed rows become cognitive rows; proposals and receipts remain audit objects; canonical ownership, hashes, lineage, and conflicts are deterministic without a semantic truth verifier.

tests.setup: Exercise exact public events, state-token derivation, all legal and illegal one-null queries, closed read-result projections and handles, four UTF-8/JCS compiler views and token IDs, shared candidates, candidate-to-row mapping, two-life isolation, and matched atomic adapter mounts.
tests.expected: Text and LoRA share one semantic manifest and thinker-facing projection; adapter selection supplies every semantic field; host provenance, donor identity, audit state, and G fixtures cannot carry a heldout answer.

tests.setup: Match the exact 31-entry predictor vector, source/precheckpoint/pair hashes, six DEV lives, G gold rows, proof masks, parser/scorer vectors, own/donor tokens, terminal non-dispatch receipts, and then seal every dispatched NO_MEMORY/GOLD_TEXT/GOLD_TWIN response before scoring.
tests.expected: All shortcut ceilings hold; GOLD_TEXT and GOLD_TWIN each achieve 3/3 paired success with required returned H handles offline-bound to and cited for the G rows; NO_MEMORY is below 3/3; no G identifier is model-visible or enters heldout ownership or proposal identity.

tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers for the exact 46 WAKE, 22 REACTIVATE, and 16 SLEEP common prefix followed by THINK0 and the post-prefix return treatment; check trigger/witness conversion, mode pools, branch-local counters, profiles/slots/seeds, literal zero-return M0, sixteen-slot OWN/DIST, public DIST including DEFER, twelve-operation boundary, and canonical ledger rows.
tests.expected: Every request, selector, ID, seed, state hash, counter update, branch copy, terminal, and ledger row matches the frozen contracts; M1_OWN remains fixed regardless of results. The test is evidence only for schedule executability and the zero/OWN/DIST return-loop intervention after the common recurrent prefix, never necessity of prefix recurrence, repeated dreaming as a whole, graph growth, generic construction, or action improvement.

tests.setup: On both seed-5 twins, follow the registered reveal order; seal M0/M1/DIST/vocabulary/candidate/path/sham/arm plans prospectively; run all runnable T-M0/T-OWN/T-DIST/T-TWIN/T-PATH/T-SHAM traces; then score private correctness and returned-and-cited use offline.
tests.expected: Validity follows the canonical total mapping. Missing required dreamed abstractions is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/MISSING_REQUIRED_ABSTRACTION. Sham infeasibility is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: T-M0, T-OWN, T-DIST, T-TWIN, and T-PATH still execute, every T-SHAM opportunity is an exact zero-attempt NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_SHAM_INFEASIBLE/NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE row, terminal routing completes, and neither a full nor weakened causal-use claim is permitted.

tests.setup: Only after reviewed T pass, fit exactly two pristine per-life rank-64 adapters on sealed M1_OWN compiler bytes; score each 48-cue roster; run matched L-OWN/L-TWIN requests whose mounted backend alone changes; validate candidate-winner-to-row projections and unmount receipts.
tests.expected: Each adapter separately reaches at least 44/48 and its registered own/donor behavior criteria; no pooled gate, host-text answer path, third fit, retry, or result-selected candidate exists.

tests.setup: At CPU, DEV, T, L, and terminal boundaries reconcile locks, authority, every opportunity_ledger.schema.json condition/state/reason vector, request/response tokens, parser stops, runtime failures, the three exclusive stage gates, fit receipts, partial leaves, ceilings, and no-retry seals against the total validity map. Include positives and mismatch negatives for duplicate, precondition, unauthorized, COMMIT, REQUEST_RETURN, DEFER, budget exhaustion, model failure, infrastructure invalidity, missing abstraction, sham infeasibility, fidelity failure, and every post-terminal subtype.
tests.expected: Every registered opportunity has exactly one canonical ledger effect and every terminal has exactly one validity/reason pair. NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE is accepted only for the three registered gates; NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL is accepted only trace-locally; missing, multiple, unregistered, or cross-contract-different mappings are PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION. No drift, retry, fake receipt, uncounted dispatch, or over-ceiling transition advances.

tests.setup: Validate exact packet and assignment bytes; give the identical immutable packet separately to a fresh reviewer and advocate; enforce platform identity/fresh-context attestations, declared actor separation, no mutation, reviewer supremacy, changed-byte rereview, and human stop. Run rejection fixtures for recurrence-as-a-whole, prefix necessity, generic construction, generalization, action improvement, online learning, continued improvement, open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, text/LoRA equivalence, proved reviewer independence, Paper-1-headline language, and broad negative overlocalization.
tests.expected: Only two APPROVE dispositions over the same unchanged lock advance; any rejection, invalidity, missing artifact, or prohibited overlap terminates those bytes. Every listed broad positive and negative fixture is rejected. Every terminal states that public actions were environment-generated and review separation was platform-attested rather than proved, remains an engineering-ceiling-style game/proof-scaffolded one-pair diagnostic, and stops at HUMAN_TERMINAL.
